jobs.title: Senior Director, Partner Success
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Director, Partner Success based in Canada.

We are seeking a strategic and commercially minded leader to build and scale a high-performing Partner Success organization within a growing B2B software environment. Reporting to the Chief Business Officer, you will define the strategy, operating model, and partner engagement approach that help partners deliver measurable customer value and grow their businesses. You will oversee the entire partner lifecycle, from onboarding and enablement to adoption, retention, renewal, and expansion. Working across Sales, Customer Success, Product, Marketing, Support, Operations, and Finance, you will strengthen collaboration and align partner outcomes with business objectives. This role combines executive relationship management, operational leadership, and data-driven decision-making to improve partner productivity and long-term commercial performance. The position is remote within Canada, with occasional travel for team meetings, company events, and partner engagement.

Accountabilities

Build the Partner Success organization: Define the overall strategy, team structure, coverage model, and investment priorities. Recruit, coach, and develop a high-performing team, including managers, with clear accountability and measurable objectives.
Design the partner lifecycle: Establish scalable partner journeys covering onboarding, activation, enablement, adoption, renewal, and expansion, with clear milestones, ownership, and escalation processes.
Develop partner engagement models: Create differentiated approaches for technology and strategic partners, combining dedicated relationship support with digital programs and self-service resources.
Drive joint success planning: Establish collaborative success plans and executive business reviews that connect partner capabilities, customer adoption, service delivery, and commercial growth.
Strengthen partner enablement: Work with enablement and technical teams to deliver training, certifications, deployment readiness, and repeatable practices that help partners achieve successful customer outcomes.
Manage partner retention and growth: Identify partner and customer risks early, coordinate recovery plans, and uncover opportunities for expansion while clarifying responsibilities across renewals and commercial execution.
Measure partner performance: Build partner health scores, dashboards, forecasting inputs, and business review frameworks to evaluate engagement, productivity, retention, and growth.
Champion continuous improvement: Translate partner feedback and performance insights into improvements across products, programs, processes, and support experiences.
Lead cross-functional collaboration: Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders across Sales, Customer Success, Product, Marketing, Support, Operations, and Finance to align priorities and improve partner outcomes.
Drive operational excellence: Translate strategic objectives into repeatable processes, establish clear performance standards, and lead organizational change as the partner ecosystem scales.

Requirements

Leadership experience: 12+ years of experience in Partner Success, Customer Success, channel operations, or related functions within B2B software, including experience leading teams and managing managers.
Organizational scaling: Demonstrated success building or expanding partner-facing organizations, with measurable improvements in partner productivity, customer retention, expansion, and satisfaction.
Partner business models: Strong understanding of partner economics, particularly managed service providers (MSPs) and resellers, including recurring revenue models, service delivery, and profitable partner practices.
Partner lifecycle expertise: Experience designing lifecycle programs, partner segmentation, success plans, health scoring, and executive engagement strategies across diverse partner portfolios.
Commercial and analytical judgment: Ability to connect partner engagement and customer adoption with revenue outcomes, investment decisions, and broader business performance.
Executive relationship management: Proven ability to build trust with partner leaders, manage complex escalations, and influence strategic priorities across internal and external stakeholders.
Cross-functional leadership: Experience working effectively with Sales, Customer Success, Product, Marketing, Support, Operations, and Finance to deliver coordinated partner strategies.
Strategic execution: Ability to translate business strategy into scalable processes, lead through change, establish accountability, and deliver measurable results in a growing organization.
Communication and influencing skills: Strong interpersonal, presentation, and stakeholder management capabilities, with the confidence to engage senior executives and guide complex discussions.
Adaptability: Comfort operating in a fast-paced environment with ambiguity, evolving priorities, and a strong focus on outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications

AI-forward environment: Experience working in an organization that actively adopts AI to improve productivity, collaboration, and business operations.
Industry experience: Background in cybersecurity, identity and access management, or another technically complex Software as a Service (SaaS) category.
Technology-enabled partner programs: Familiarity with using digital tools, data, and automation to improve partner engagement and lifecycle management.

Benefits

Competitive annual salary: CAD $240,000–$360,000 for Canada-based candidates.
Equity: Eligibility for an equity grant, with restricted stock unit (RSU) programs available to most employees.
Incentive opportunities: Participation in applicable incentive programs.
Health and wellbeing: Competitive health and dental benefits.
Retirement savings: Retirement matching program and RRSP benefits.
Paid time off: Generous paid time off policy.
Family support: Maternity and parental leave top-up programs.
Remote-first work: Work remotely from your home country, with travel for relevant in-person team meetings, company offsites, and partner or industry events.
Professional development and recognition: Opportunities to grow within a collaborative environment, with peer-to-peer recognition through Bonusly.
Additional benefit: Free access to a 1Password account.
Community involvement: Paid volunteer days.
Inclusive workplace: Commitment to an equitable and supportive environment, with accommodations available throughout the recruitment process.
